item.title: Bain Pushes Back LNG Glut Outlook to 2030 as War Tightens Market
item.description: A looming global glut of liquefied natural gas has been pushed back by more than a year as the conflict in the Middle East disrupts supplies and delays projects, according to Bain & Co., extending a period of tightness that’s delivering higher profits for traders.

item.title: Former SEC Chair Gary Gensler Warns Anthropic’s Cash Flow Poses Big Risk To AI Economy
item.description: Gary Gensler, former SEC Chair and Professor of the Practice of Global Economics and Management and Finance at MIT Sloan School of Management, joined Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick about Anthropic and OpenAI’s corporate governance structure, the evolving role of the SEC, and risk factors he’s watching. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Chicago’s Third CFO This Year Saw Red Flags Before Exit
item.description: The sudden departure of Chicago’s third chief financial officer in a year came after she repeatedly raised concerns about budgeting practices, including inconsistent deficit calculations.
